scene_analysis.scene_overview: A view of a subway station with two ticket machines, a clock, and a man holding bags. The station has a white wall with a black ceiling and gray floor made up of square tiles. A large screen is mounted on the wall displaying information. There is a trashcan next to the man. The ticket machines are yellow and gray with a digital display. The clock is round and white with black hands. The man is wearing a blue shirt and dark pants.
scene_analysis.buildings: The building is white with a flat roof and a small ledge protruding from the wall. It has a smooth texture and is made of concrete or metal. The building is tall and narrow.
scene_analysis.materials: The ticket machines have a yellow front panel with a digital display and buttons. They are made of metal and plastic. The clock is attached to the wall above them.
